skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Masterpiece
skins.content: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Masterpiece. The outfit worn by Natalya Andreyevna Rostova, student council president of Chernobog #4 Secondary School, during her commencement speech.
skins.quote: Count Rostov sees his eldest daughter as his magnum opus. But after an unexpected encounter with adversity, Natalya chooses to be herself.

skins.name: Forever Together
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Forever Together. Black tea, lemon, colorful little sweets, and lots of soft, friendly companions. Forget stiff manners and anything that ties you down, and just lie back. Your friends' warm, welcoming arms are always there to embrace you.
skins.quote: Natalya still knows exactly what makes an afternoon tea perfect—the colors, the frosting, the tea at just the right warmth. But right now? That doesn't matter at all. 'Phew… I'll just lie here for a bit. Just a little bit, that's all.'
